label: Closed R1–R3 and informational controls on the labeled enumeration semantics: the endpoint plus…
description: R1: reconstruct a bijective enumeration from its endpoint and complete successor table by Nat induction. R2: use Cardinal.mk_arrow for binary vectors and exhibit a well-founded empty Unit relation; every upstream enumeration chain instead has a predecessor at every node, refuting its WF. R3: the same finite inductive reconstruction proves the universal conditional rule. Reuse HistorySelection.EvidenceOnly literally: constant truth cannot distinguish a swapped-label rival, while all endpoint/link equality facts determine the arrangement. These are structural and informational controls, not a proof of complete explanation or a defeat of an actual worldview. All philosophical adequacy/admissibility bridges remain open; no root premise is discharged.
